title: A 30-second tour of example.com
goal: Show that a walkthrough can introduce a page, point at a link, follow it, and come back - the smallest storyboard that exercises every kind of step.
audience: Someone evaluating evo.videostroll; they know what a website is.

steps.narration: This is example.com, the placeholder site the internet uses for exactly this purpose. Everything on it fits in one screen.
The heading is the only thing on the page that is not a paragraph or a link.
There is one link, and it leads to the documentation for why this domain exists.
Clicking it opens the IANA page that reserves these names.
The page is longer than the first screen, so the cursor scrolls, and the recording follows it down.
And back to the start. That is the whole tour.
